tools.name: start_travel_insurance_comparison
tools.description: Prepares a travel insurance comparison on Checko for a trip abroad from Israel and returns a trip card with a link that continues on checko.co.il. Inputs are trip details only: destination, dates, travellers' ages and optional activities and extras; there are no fields for names, contact details, bi

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Lists the destination regions and countries that Checko's travel insurance comparison accepts, optionally filtered by a search term (Hebrew or English). Read-only.

tools.name: list_coverage_options
tools.description: Lists the optional activities and extras available in Checko's travel insurance comparison, with their names on Checko. Medical extensions are not offered here. Read-only.

tools.name: list_insurers
tools.description: Lists the Israeli insurers whose travel insurance offers Checko compares. Read-only; no prices.
